AIONix works with Artemis only, and every single Artemis is supplied with the system cartridge. 
The only scenario of the standalone system offering makes sense to me when there is a minor update (other than networking edition or AIONix 2) e.g. 1.1 version provides with small extensions. In such case old version cartridge can be replaced with new one for a small fee.
Such update cartridge replacements can be also bundled with the existing support service. 
The other scenario when system is provided to clone makers will be part or OEM contract rather than an official offering.

Let's turn this product to one-off system update (when old cartridge is replaced with the latest one) via Computerland/Academy facilities. 
Neither underlying software edition record nor this products mentions cartridge BOM in the composition section. 
Product shouldn't have technology references and feature specification, but rather leave such information to software edition records.

Customer Care can be purchased after a year of support service as a downgraded extension of the initial period.
Given that product provides annual extension it should contain information about time. 
Make specification more meaningful:
- having numbers type doesn't need to be unique, I prefer "feature" over "features[1]" 
- description should be descriptive, and concise using plain English while value should contain key element e.g. type: "duration" description:"The service remains in effect for a specified period, after which it expires unless it is extended." value: "1 year"

Logix Computer Academy - customer-site courses product doesn't make sense. 
There are different courses for different products and any of them can be either conducted in the Logix Computer academy facility or in customer's office.
this record to be removed (the flexibility of the location should be mentioned as a feature of specific courses).

When I read event.ncc82_graphics_mouse description is looks to me that the offering for this conference covers new Color Pro 14 monitor, 64k graphics card, entertainment suite, mouse and system updates for AIONix and CP/M 
but it doesn't cover Mono Pro 17 monitor and 128KB graphics card - this to be removed from any NCC 1982 related events processes or campaign records 

I don't like impacted events: 
- descriptions refer to elements that should never be mentioned in the story: e.g."Demonstrate Team Edition at its $745.23 adoption price, provide target/API documentation, porting clinics and partner compatibility demonstrations. Funding does not imply exclusive software ownership. Budget and campaign plan: ncc_1982_campaign.json" refers to price that is never part of the event, mentions json files that are not part of this project. 
- id doesn't make sense that every single event mention all products. some events should focuss on marketing actions , prodcuts can be the outcomes of the overal process connected with campaign of its sub-process and then don't need to be referenced anywhere else again.
